PLAN "Bodyweight Strength: 12 Weeks Beginner (No Equipment)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational strength with bodyweight exercises"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          squat 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 1m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          high_knees 3m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 3x2..5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
    WEEK 2:
